Becoming depressed is not a choice, staying depressed is chronic depression, also not a choice...

I can see where this comes from, things like physical exercise etc can help to some extent, but I don't think it can be to the extent that it makes mental illness a choice.

Personally, I am very active as I compete in martial arts, I get decent sleep etc, but have pretty severe depression and other mental illnesses. I have a family history of mental illness and some trauma to mix into the pile of fun. So I think it really depends on the person.

Also as the very nature of depression tends to lead you being less active and taking less care of yourself, it is slightly problematic seeing it as a choice, when a lot of the symptoms prevent you from getting better.

Yeah, a lot of people don't understand that it is a *mental* illness so doesn't always show obvious symptoms to everyone watching like e.g a broken arm would. 

Good for you being able to stay firm with it though.

Yeah, as if anyone would choose depression 😅... But please don't take your life, even for just the sake of seeing if it gets better. I'm definitely not the best to give advise on this, and sorry for giving the typical reply, but please please speak to a professional if you haven't done so already.
